AdditionsNone: There is no additions file yet. "Open file" creates it with a description of the format.
AdditionsNotApplied: The file has errors and is not used; the built-in phrases work.
AdditionsMissingWords: These words are not in the speech model and cannot be recognized by voice (typed text works): {0}
OpenFileFailed: The file could not be opened: {0}
BrowserFailed: The browser could not be opened. Copy the address:
CrashMessage: Collect diagnostics and attach the archive to your problem report — it makes the problem easier to find.
DiagnosticsNote: The log holds only what the app does: start, settings, model, game, button and errors. Nothing of your phrases — no audio, no text — is in it. The diagnostics archive holds the logs, crash reports, settings and your command additions; you can open and check it before sending. PitVoice itself never sends it anywhere.
NoticesLink: Full list of components and licenses (THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md)
UpdateAvailableMessage: The update is downloaded and installed only when you press the button. Settings, models and phrase additions stay.
UpdateDownloading: Downloading the update: {0}%. PitVoice keeps working.
UpdateFound: Version {0} is available — see the update block on the Home page.
UpdatesOnlyInstalled: Updates are available only in the installed version.
CheckForUpdatesNote: At start and once a day PitVoice looks for a newer version in the project releases on GitHub. Nothing about you is sent; an update is installed only when you press the button.
